summary: Online research supported the REV0156 implementation: Hugging Face env vars are read at import time; Transformers offline mode requires pre-downloaded/cached files; HF_HUB_OFFLINE blocks Hub HTTP calls; and HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS can duplicate huge files, so the runner now guards cache duplication and supports wheelhouse/no-index bootstrap.

sources.observed: Docs state environment variables are read at huggingface_hub import time and define HF_HOME/HF_HUB_CACHE/HF_XET_CACHE/HF_ASSETS_CACHE, timeout controls, HF_HUB_OFFLINE, and HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS duplication risk.
Docs state offline Transformers usage requires model files downloaded/cached ahead of time and can load local directories with local_files_only=True.

implementation_consequence: dry-run must be safe through the one-command wrapper, not only the child bootstrap script
external runners may need no-index wheelhouse bootstrap rather than ambient/system Python or public package index access
HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS requires an explicit duplication override because the TinyLlama snapshot path is large enough for accidental cache duplication to matter
